annotations.title: Show the local cache location, schema and per-user coverage

description: Diagnostics for the LOCAL check-in cache — NO API call. Returns the resolved cache file path, its size on disk (db + WAL), journal mode, schema version, the number of cached menu-line resolutions and beer-metadata rows, cached venues, and for every cached user: cached vs total distinct beers, cached check-ins, coverage_complete, the resume offset of an unfinished user/beers backfill, last_synced_at, and venue-history coverage (venues: cached vs total, complete, percent, next_offset; null if never synced), wishlist and Untappd brewery-likes mirror coverage (wishlist / brewery_likes: cached vs total, complete; null if never synced). Also reports rate_limit: API calls made in the last hour (this process plus any other sharing the cache file), the ~100/hour limit, the estimated calls left, the raw X-Ratelimit-* headers (the v4 API sends Remaining: 0 on every success, so it is ignored until it reports a live value) and any 429 wait. Use it to confirm the cache persisted across restarts, to see how far a backfill has got, or to check whether a sync can run now.
name: untappd_cache_status
